citation: Pichon M, Burucoa C, ADNEMIA Study Group. Diagnostic performance of the DISQVER metagenomic sequencing tool for the identification of pathogens in febrile neutropenic patients: the ADNEMIA trial. BMJ Open. 2025;15:e087773.
study_design: Study protocol (published protocol of a nationwide, prospective, multicentre, interventional, proof-of-concept trial; ClinicalTrials.gov NCT06075888)
study_period: Trial planned at publication (protocol article; received 2024 Apr 18, accepted 2025 Jan 6)

population.n_haemato_or_transplant: planned: adults >=18 y with solid tumour or haematological malignancy, high-risk FN (MASCC <=21, expected neutropenia >=7 days)

neutropenic_status: Neutropenia defined as ANC <1500/mm3; high-risk FN = MASCC score <=21 with expected neutropenia >=7 days

specimens.type: blood (plasma cfDNA in Streck tubes, shipped to Noscendo GmbH, Reutlingen)
conventional work-up specimens (blood culture, urine culture, EBV/CMV PCR, Aspergillus serology/antigen, beta-D-glucan)

index_test.platform_or_panel: mNGS-DISQVER (Noscendo; CE-marked diagnostic device; proprietary database of >16,000 microbial genomes incl. 1500 pathogens)
index_test.dna_and_or_rna: DNA (plasma cell-free DNA; bacteria, DNA viruses, fungi, parasites)

reference_standard: Conventional work-up classification used as benchmark; independent blinded adjudication committee (blinded to mNGS results when adjudicating conventional results and vice versa)
additional_yield_vs_conventional: Not reported (planned secondary outcome: microorganisms detected during routine care vs mNGS-DISQVER)
turnaround_time: Planned: samples processed within 48 hours for metagenomic analysis
therapy_change: Planned secondary outcome (escalation, maintenance, de-escalation or discontinuation of anti-infective treatment); no results
quadas2_notes: This is a trial PROTOCOL with no results, yields, or diagnostic counts. Not extractable for meta-analysis; flag for future results of NCT06075888.

evidence_quotes.quote: This nationwide, prospective, multicentre, interventional, proof-of-concept clinical trial will enrol 200 patients.
Will include patients≥18 years old, treated for malignancy, at high risk of FN (Multinational Association for Supportive Care in Cancer score≤21) with an expected duration of neutropenia≥ 7 days.
The trial has been registered on ClinicalTrials.gov (identifier NCT06075888
DISQVER is a digital analytical solution developed by Noscendo for the rapid, hypothesis-free identification of microorganisms in a patient’s blood sample from free circulating DNA.
interpretation of the conventional assessment and that provided by the mNGS-DISQVER tool will be blinded
The diagnostic abilities of the new mNGS-DISQVER test will be evaluated based on its sensitivity and specificity, using the conventional work-up classification as the benchmark.
On receipt, the samples will be processed within 48 hours for metagenomic analysis using an accredited method as part of the mNGS-DISQVER diagnostic kit.

exclusion_reason: Study protocol only - no results/data reported
